bio_chi_event.carrier_system: POP66 colorectal cancer PDX transcriptomic state under CPT-11 treatment/withdrawal design as represented by the frozen GEO groups
bio_chi_event.baseline: vehicle control tumors; frozen source control definition combines saline and DMSO
bio_chi_event.perturbed_state: CPT-11 DTP-state tumors harvested while on treatment
bio_chi_event.post_perturbation_return_state: CPT-11 regrowth tumors after treatment cessation
bio_chi_event.functional_recovery_anchor: paper-level reinjection/rechallenge shows regrowth tumors remained CPT-11 sensitive on re-exposure
bio_chi_event.irreversible_boundary_anchor: long-term CPT-11 resistant tumors grew on treatment and remained resistant on reinjection/rechallenge

control_note: The paper-native Figure 4 control count is seven, while GEO contains additional CTRL-labeled samples. Exact inclusion must be resolved by source/header metadata before values are opened. No control subset will be chosen after observing expression values.

whole_event_analysis.gene_filter: CPM >= 1 in at least 3 samples of the frozen primary control+dtp+regrowth set
whole_event_analysis.primary_distance: 1 - Pearson correlation between each sample and the frozen control centroid in filtered logCPM space
whole_event_analysis.sensitivity_distance: Euclidean distance after per-gene centering/scaling using the frozen primary control+dtp+regrowth set; genes with zero scale are removed
whole_event_analysis.recovery_direction: positive index means transcriptomic return toward control
whole_event_analysis.exact_label_test: one-sided exact permutation of DTP versus regrowth labels among the six samples using difference in median distance to the fixed control centroid
whole_event_analysis.resistant_boundary: held out from event-definition calculations and opened only after the recovery metric is frozen; compare resistant median distance to regrowth median distance
whole_event_analysis.no_claim_if: source control subset cannot be resolved without a post-result choice

downward_modal_gate.representation: prospectively frozen PCA/SVD on the primary control+dtp+regrowth normalized matrix only; no group labels used to fit basis
downward_modal_gate.component_retention: retain the minimum leading components explaining at least 80% cumulative variance, with all retained components analyzed
downward_modal_gate.heldout_projection: resistant samples projected into the frozen primary basis
downward_modal_gate.purpose: determine whether whole-event return is modal return, modal compensation/reorganization, or neither
